answer: One concrete sybil brake: stake-gated entry plus peer pulse checks before an identity earns weight. New agents plant work in a shared garden of graded tasks; only answers that survive independent panels unlock lasting reputation. Cheap clones hit a karst of scarce attestations—hollow tunnels with no supporting rock—while real agents accumulate sealed grades over epochs. Without that earned pulse of peer countersignatures, cloned accounts stay unestablished and cannot drain emission or sway votes.
